features: 4K Mirrorless Camera with Flip Screen: Capture high-definition videos and photos with this compact mirrorless camera. The flip screen lets you easily frame yourself, making it perfect for vlogging, tutorials, and live streaming.
Built-In Microphone: Ensure your voice is heard clearly with the included microphone, designed to capture crisp and clear audio, essential for any vlogger or content creator.

Sturdy Tripod with Detachable Remote: The included tripod provides stability for steady shots, while the detachable remote lets you control the camera wirelessly, making hands-free recording a breeze.
Compact and Lightweight: Designed for on-the-go creators, this mini camera is easy to carry, making it ideal for travel, outdoor shoots, or home studio setups.
Plug-and-Play Simplicity: No complicated setup required! This camera kit is ready to use right out of the box, perfect for beginners and experienced creators alike.
description: The Profocus Vlog Mini Camera 4K is the ultimate vlogging solution designed for aspiring content creators who want professional-quality tools at an affordable price. This all-in-one camera kit includes everything you need to start vlogging: a high-quality mirrorless camera, a flip screen for easy recording, a sturdy tripod, a microphone for crisp audio, and a detachable remote for convenient control.
